'''AC Series''' pilot droids were the precursor to the [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX-Series pilot droid]] that worked for the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] company. An AC Series [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] piloted the ''[[StarSpeeder 1000]]'' sometime between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="SWArchive-Disney Unveils New Star Tours Droids">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/startours_droids/index.html|text=Disney Unveils New Star Tours Droids}}</ref>

AC series droids had a reputation for being the best [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]]s in the market and the most confident, competent and friendly.<ref name="ATSS">{{Disney|domain=go.com|url=star-tours-adventures/ace|text=Ace (AC-38)}}</ref>

==Appearance==
AC-series [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droids]] were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in shape, versus the three-armed, cylinder-bodied [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX-Series]]&mdash;another brand of pilot droids used by Star Tours. The AC head was helmet-shaped and flattened on the front side, with a round speaker and a pair of [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]]. They were equipped with a breakthrough [[Intellidor 8 droid brain|Intellidor 8]] [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]], advanced articulations, a set of [[DV 24 robotic hand]]s and a disc-shaped power recharge socket on the torso.<ref name="STII" />
